unit.unitinstructions:
Welcome to Statistics Formula Identification

This tutor will help you master the essential formulas used in introductory statistics courses.

How this works

You will be shown a statistical formula or equation, and you need to identify what it represents by typing a short label. For example:

  • Formula: σ = √[Σ(X - μ)² / N]
  • Answer: Population SD

What's covered

  • Descriptive Statistics (mean, median, variance, standard deviation)
  • Standardization (z-scores, t-scores)
  • Inferential Statistics (confidence intervals, hypothesis tests)
  • Correlation and Regression
  • Probability Rules
  • Distribution Formulas (binomial, normal, Poisson)

Tips for success

  • Be specific: distinguish between population (μ, σ) and sample (x̄, s) statistics
  • Use consistent abbreviations (e.g., SD for standard deviation, SE for standard error)
  • The system adapts to your performance, bringing back challenging formulas more frequently
  • Take your time to read each formula carefully

Click Next when you're ready to begin!
